Party Size Pizza
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:29am

Ingredients




2 pounds Hot sausage
2 pounds Mild sausage
2 pounds Pasteurized process cheese
3 Loaves party bread

Preparation

1 Brown sausage in skillet. Do NOT drain! Add cut up cheese until it melts. 2 Spread on bread. Freeze overnight on cookie sheets. The next day put in freezer bags to store. Do not thaw to bake. Bake 30 minutes at 350.
